articles.title: Circle shares fall 3% despite earnings beat as stablecoin issuer misses on revenue
articles.snippet: Shares initially jumped 10% but later fell 3% in pre-market trading as the stablecoin issuer revealed institutional adoption for its layer 1 blockchain Arc but missed on revenue.

articles.title: Mastercard, Borderless test shared identity checks for stablecoin transfers
articles.snippet: Mastercard and Borderless are exploring ways to bring more trust into cross-border stablecoin transfers through the payment processing giant’s Crypto Credential framework.

articles.title: OpenAI Dumps Apple Employees' Text Messages to Fight Trade Secret Suit
articles.snippet: The ChatGPT maker released emails and text messages it says expose factual errors in Apple's lawsuit and undercut claims that former Apple employees brought confidential information to the company.

articles.title: Crypto Privacy Tools Serve ‘Essential Protective Functions’: Report by ChangeNOW, CoinRabbit
articles.snippet: Authoritarian oppression, corporate treasuries and “wrench attacks” make up the privacy case in a new report from ChangeNOW and CoinRabbit.

articles.title: Morning Minute: The Coldcard Bitcoin Hack Nears $114 Million in Potential Losses
articles.snippet: Self-custody is under attack, and it's becoming increasingly clear that AI is one of crypto's leading threats.
